result_text:
The three "latest orders" lists (overall, per region, per customer) now leave out archived orders as well as cancelled ones. The full `mvn -q -o test` run passes. I didn't add a test for your Alpha/Beta example, and I didn't check whether the existing tests cover it.

The change is in `SalesOrderQuery.latest(int)` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. It now adds the same not-archived filter that the open-order lists and order search use. All three lists are built from that method, so the one change covers them. I also updated the Javadoc on that method and on the three `findLatestSalesOrders*` methods to say archived orders are left out.

Nothing is committed.
